column3: “to play the harlot with” renders “to commit fornication (zanah) into.”
“joined themselves to” renders “yoked itself (tsamad) to” (also in verse 5).
“execute them” renders a rare verb (hoqa) meaning to impale or expose; “in broad daylight” renders “before the sun,” and “the fierce anger” renders “the burning of the anger.”
“the tent” renders “qubbah,” an inner chamber, and “through the body” renders “into her belly”; “was checked” renders “was restrained.”
“My wrath” renders “my rage,” and “destroy” renders “make an end of.”
“My covenant of peace” renders “my covenant, peace.”
“head of the people” renders “head of the tribes (ummot).”
